description: Private TupleHash/TupleHashXOF component over the existing accelerated cSHAKE engine, with streamed customization, exact item framing and retained composition. Ordinary native processes, not VBS.
framing: Scalar owner framing retained; scalar bit packer equality enforced apart from borrowed-state lifetime annotations

miri.scope: Actual bit-packer source with a noncryptographic byte sink; eight initial alignments and ten input widths, plus failure/clear/reuse; no kernel, enclave, placement or whole-owner cleanup claim

source_binding.remote_checkout: Restored development checkout plus source overlay, not a clean exact Git checkout

limitations: Component only: no accelerated TupleHash enclave image, wire protocol, resident placement or supported host constructor yet
Whole-allocation erasure including inactive variants/padding and current-image ABI/register/spill/dump review remain pending
No production signing, Windows ARM64, arbitrary migration, independent cryptographic review or certification claim
Existing scalar worker, shipping APIs, kernels, dependencies and release-gate policy unchanged
